https://mastodon.social/@BmeBenji@mstdn..text: Been playing #Fallout #NewVegas for the first time (after I bought it in a Steam sale ~12 years ago lol). First Fallout game I’m really investing time into. I enjoy the writing and the stories of the factions I’ve met, but I don’t fully understand what it is that most people love about this game, or what makes it among the greatest games ever made. The world seems well-realized which is admirable, but I don’t see what makes it amazing. Maybe once I meet Benny it’ll make more sense. #Gaming
